verdict.rationale: Devin's CLI docs describe Adaptive as an automatic model router (devin-docs-10, devin-docs-26). They state explicitly that you can switch away from Adaptive to a specific model at any time with /model (devin-docs-11), which directly delivers the story. Missing for 10: documentation of which models can be selected, evidence that model choice extends beyond the CLI to web/cloud sessions or can be set by an org admin, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
